title: Raw go-livepeer Kafka GatewayEvent
description: Mixed-topic envelope emitted by monitor.SendQueueEventAsync in go-livepeer v0.9.2 at commit 38eb47d12ab1d2d874fc4c7c061aa1900b7c0bad. Consumers ignore unrelated event types and apply the create_signed_ticket schema only after filtering on type.

timestamp.description: Signed int64 Unix epoch milliseconds encoded as a decimal string. Consumers enforce the exact int64 bound.
